netlist:
* Spicey Electrons circuit at 20 C
.options rshunt=1e12 reltol=1e-3 method=gear
.temp 20
vam_G1 n2 G1_am 0
R_G1_i0 n1 0 10Meg
B_G1 G1_x 0 V = 5*(1-(0.5*(1+tanh((v(n1)-2.5)/0.2))))
R_G1_d G1_x G1_y 1000
C_G1_d G1_y 0 10p
B_G1_buf G1_o 0 V = v(G1_y)
R_G1_out G1_o G1_am 50
.ic v(G1_y)=0
vam_G2 n3 G2_am 0
R_G2_i0 n2 0 10Meg
B_G2 G2_x 0 V = 5*(1-(0.5*(1+tanh((v(n2)-2.5)/0.2))))
R_G2_d G2_x G2_y 1030
C_G2_d G2_y 0 10p
B_G2_buf G2_o 0 V = v(G2_y)
R_G2_out G2_o G2_am 50
.ic v(G2_y)=5
vam_G3 n1 G3_am 0
R_G3_i0 n3 0 10Meg
B_G3 G3_x 0 V = 5*(1-(0.5*(1+tanh((v(n3)-2.5)/0.2))))
R_G3_d G3_x G3_y 1060
C_G3_d G3_y 0 10p
B_G3_buf G3_o 0 V = v(G3_y)
R_G3_out G3_o G3_am 50
.ic v(G3_y)=0
.control
set filetype=binary
tran 1e-09 1e-06 0 1e-09
write __OUT__ v(n1) v(n2) v(n3) i(vam_g1) i(vam_g2) i(vam_g3)
quit
.endc
.end
